content.text: Updating the artifact with detailed per-bug explanations and more code context.

input.contents:
6 critical bugs 8 medium 3 low 5 / 5 tests passing

code.ipynb → clean Python package

41-cell Colab notebook converted to src/inpainting/ (7 modules) + tests/ + requirements.txt. Below: each bug with impact, notebook evidence, and the fix. Heavy TF training still needs a GPU machine - data utilities are fully tested here.

Notebook cells
41
Bugs found
17
New modules
7

How the mess maps to the new layout

Question answered: where did each notebook concern go?

Bug index — skim first, then open details

Critical rows silently corrupt training; medium rows waste compute or break portability; low rows are hygiene.

#LocationOne-linerSeverity
1cell 10Global image_paths → train/test leakcritical
2cells 25/40mode='max' on val_loss saves worst weightscritical
3cell 24on_epoch_end args swappedcritical
4cell 31tf.ones_like(16) scalar GAN targetscritical
5cell 36VAE loss vs masked input; MAE discardedcritical
6cell 6preprocess → −1..0 + in-place mutationcritical
7cell 7show_image casts −1..1 → black squaresmedium
8cell 6Substring match includes fakejpg.txtmedium
9cell 6No imread guard; cv2 (w,h) order trapmedium
10cell 10Ignores split_shape; double disk loadmedium
11cell 31Triple __getitem__, shared tape, no reshufflemedium
12cell 36sqrt(512+latent) ≈ 24-unit bottleneckmedium
13cell 16/36Final conv linear vs −1..1 targetsmedium
14cells 0–3+Colab/Drive/hardcoded paths/wandb.loginmedium
15cell 11Hardcoded 5000 split; test set shuffleslow
16cell 28BN after ReLU; dead init_zero_weightslow
17variousDead imports; duplicate loss / G+D buildlow

Bug deep-dives

Each card: what broke, why it matters, notebook evidence, and where it was fixed.

critical #1

Train/test leak via global image_paths

Where: cell 10, WikiArtDataset.__getitem__ · Fixed in: src/inpainting/data.py

Why it matters
Both train and test datasets sliced the same global image_paths by batch index. Validation batches came from the full corpus (including training images), so val_loss was meaningless and the model was scored on data it may already have seen.
Fix
Store a copied list on the instance (self.image_paths = list(image_paths)) and always slice that. Train and test now own disjoint path lists from split_paths().
critical #2

Checkpoint mode='max' on val_loss

Where: cells 25 and 40, ModelCheckpoint · Fixed in: callbacks.py → make_checkpoint()

Why it matters
Loss is lower-is-better. With mode='max' and save_best_only=True, Keras kept weights at peak validation loss - the worst epoch. Reloading those weights for inference or continued training started from the model's worst checkpoint.
Fix
make_checkpoint() always uses mode="min" for loss monitors.
critical #3

PredictionLogger.on_epoch_end args swapped

Where: cell 24 · Fixed in: callbacks.py

Why it matters
Keras calls on_epoch_end(self, epoch, logs=None). The notebook defined (self, logs, epoch), so epoch received the metrics dict and logs received an integer. Epoch-keyed logging and sample dumps were wrong or crashed.
Fix
Correct signature (self, epoch, logs=None); deprocess images before wandb.Image(...).
critical #4

GAN targets: tf.ones_like(16) (scalar)

Where: cell 31, custom GAN loop · Fixed in: gan.py

Why it matters
tf.ones_like(16) / zeros_like(16) produce a scalar. MSE against a spatial discriminator map only "works" via broadcasting, which mis-weights elements and hides shape bugs. Adversarial gradients did not match D's output geometry.
Fix
Build targets with ones_like(real_pred) / zeros_like(fake_pred) so label tensors match discriminator output shape exactly.
critical #5

VAE loss vs masked input; MAE discarded

Where: cell 36, OutputLayer._vae_loss · Fixed in: models.py + train.py

Why it matters
add_loss compared reconstruction to the masked model input (holes are zeros), then returned 10*kl_loss with MAE commented out. Training was effectively KL-only: the decoder was not supervised to fill holes with clean pixels.
Fix
Compile with loss="mean_absolute_error" so MAE is vs clean y from the dataset. KL stays as a weighted add_loss term on the VAE model.
critical #6

preprocess: wrong range + mutates caller

Where: cell 6 · Fixed in: data.py · Test: test_preprocess_range_and_no_mutation

Why it matters
Comment claimed −0.5..0.5; code did x /= 255; x -= 1 → actual range −1..0. In-place ops mutated caller buffers. Targets no longer matched intended tanh range; reused arrays were silently corrupted.
Fix
Pure function: cast to float32, return x / 127.5 - 1.0 (symmetric −1..1).
medium #7

show_image plots black squares

Where: cell 7 (+ wandb logger used raw tensors) · Fixed in: viz.py, callbacks.py

Why it matters
Preprocessed floats in −1..0 cast with astype(int) become 0 or −1 → black pixels. Debugging, qualitative eval, and wandb image logs all looked blank, hiding whether training was progressing.
Fix
deprocess to uint8 before imshow / wandb.Image.
medium #8

find_images substring match

Where: cell 6 · Fixed in: data.py · Test: test_find_images_suffix_matching

Why it matters
if '.jpg' in file matches any name containing that substring (fakejpg.txt, not_a.jpg.backup). Polluted paths cause read failures, wrong corpus size, and junk in train/test splits.
Fix
Case-insensitive suffix match via name.lower().endswith(suffixes).
medium #9

get_image: no guard + cv2 size order

Where: cell 6 · Fixed in: data.py → load_image

Why it matters
Failed imread → cvtColor(None, …) with an opaque crash. Passing (height, width) into cv2.resize (which expects width, height) swaps axes for non-square targets and warps masks.
Fix
Raise FileNotFoundError when read fails; unpack h, w = shape then cv2.resize(image, (w, h)).
medium #10

Ignores split_shape; loads each image twice

Where: cell 10 · Fixed in: data.py → make_sample

Why it matters
Hardcoded split_shape=(3,3) ignored the dataset config. Two get_image calls per sample doubled I/O. With random masks, the two loads could apply different holes, so x and y no longer shared the same mask.
Fix
One load_image, one mask_grid, preprocess both views - uses self.split_shape.
medium #11

GAN: triple fetch, shared tape, no reshuffle

Where: cell 31 · Fixed in: gan.py

Why it matters
Three __getitem__(i) calls per step → 3× I/O and possibly different masks. Dual tapes in one with were fragile. No on_epoch_end() meant shuffled paths never reordered between epochs. create_model() inside train() also rebuilt G/D and threw away the outer models.
Fix
Load once per step; separate disc/gen tapes; call on_epoch_end() after each epoch; build models once in train_gan().
medium #12

VAE encoder crushed to ~24 units

Where: cell 36, _encoding_block · Fixed in: models.py → build_vae

Why it matters
After Flatten, features are thousands of units. int(sqrt(512 + latent_dim)) ≈ 24 for latent_dim=100. That tiny ReLU bottleneck destroys information before the latent layer - the VAE cannot represent fine detail.
Fix
Configurable hidden_dim=512 dense layer instead of the sqrt heuristic.
medium #13

Final conv is linear (unbounded)

Where: cells 16 and 36 · Fixed in: models.py (build_unet, build_vae)

Why it matters
Targets after preprocess live in −1..1. A linear final Conv2D can emit any real value; MAE/MSE push toward out-of-range pixels, viz saturates, and the GAN discriminator sees unrealistic magnitudes.
Fix
activation="tanh" on the final 3-channel conv so outputs match the data range.
medium #14

Colab-only environment assumptions

Where: cells 0–3, 19, 21, 25+ · Fixed in: config.py, train.py, requirements.txt

Why it matters
drive.mount, !pip, hardcoded Drive paths, and blocking wandb.login() made the notebook unusable locally or in CI. Paths broke on any other machine; shell installs were not reproducible.
Fix
Env-based Config (INPAINT_DATA_DIR, INPAINT_CKPT_DIR), CLI entrypoint, declared deps, optional wandb behind try/except ImportError.
low #15

Hardcoded 5000 split; test set shuffles

Where: cell 11 · Fixed in: data.py + train.py · Test: test_split_paths_deterministic_disjoint

Why it matters
Fixed train size of 5000 fails for smaller/larger corpora (comment claimed 70–30). Unseeded shuffle differed across runs. Test with shuffle=True reordered validation each epoch, so val_loss curves were not comparable.
Fix
Seeded split_paths(); train shuffles, test does not.
low #16

Discriminator: BN after ReLU

Where: cell 28 · Fixed in: models.py → conv_block

Why it matters
DCGAN order is Conv → BN → LeakyReLU. BN after ReLU normalizes already half-clipped activations, weakening batch-norm stats. Unused init_zero_weights was dead API.
Fix
Conv → BN → LeakyReLU(0.2); dead arg removed.
low #17

Dead imports, duplicate loss, duplicate G/D build

Where: cells 4, 29, 31, 36 · Fixed in: package-wide cleanup

Why it matters
Unused imports (psutil, tqdm, …) cluttered deps. Two _vae_loss methods made it unclear which ran (the broken OutputLayer version won). create_model() called again inside train() reset G/D weights.
Fix
Lazy imports; single KL in build_vae; build G/D once in train_gan(); consolidate builders in models.py.

Verification (observed, not assumed)

  • py_compile on all 7 modules + tests: pass
  • tests/test_data.py — 5 regression tests (range, no-mutation, roundtrip, suffix match, split, mask): 5/5 pass
  • All modules import without TF/CV2/matplotlib installed (lazy backends): pass
  • Full U-Net/GAN/VAE training runs need TF + GPU data — not run here, honestly out of scope for this machine.

Run it

pip install -r requirements.txt
export INPAINT_DATA_DIR=/path/to/wikiart
python -m inpainting.train autoencoder --epochs 20
python -m inpainting.train vae --epochs 20
python -m inpainting.train gan --epochs 20
